products.name: PastBook: 1-Click Photo Book App
products.description: The flagship consumer app on the App Store and Google Play with 1M+ downloads: it reads the phone camera roll by date, location, album or Yearbook mode, and the patent-pending curation engine scores image quality, removes duplicates and blurry shots, groups photos into moments and lays out a finished book in under 60 seconds. The customer previews the book for free, shares a highlight video, optionally reorders pages, swaps photos, adds captions and picks the cover photo and theme colours, then checks out with Visa, Mastercard, American Express or PayPal in one of seven currencies. Formats are the Small Hardcover 8.5" x 6" (USD 19.99 for 24 pages, USD 0.40 per extra page) and the Large Hardcover 12" x 8.5" (USD 34.99 for 24 pages, USD 0.55 per extra page), plus wall calendars and posters from the same photo set. Orders are printed by partner facilities on four continents, usually in the customer's country, and delivered within the published windows (US 4-8 business days, UK 4-5, FR/NL/IT/DE 3-5, CA/AU 5-10). Push and e-mail reminders bring families back for the next yearbook.

primaryCustomers.description: Turns tens of thousands of phone photos of the kids into a yearbook in about a minute without reviewing them one by one, and reminds the family when the next year is ready to print.

primaryCustomers.name: Traveller and Milestone Celebrant

products.name: Facebook Photo Books
products.type: Web Flow (Facebook Login, one book per year)
products.description: The pastbook.com flow that turns a Facebook account into printed yearbooks: after Facebook Login within the permission scope Meta allows, the customer picks a year from 2009 to 2025 and PastBook imports albums, timeline pictures, cover and profile photos and mobile uploads together with their captions and dates. The curation engine drops duplicates and low-quality shots and the layout generator places photos and captions chronologically, so a whole year is a finished book in one click with a free preview. Since Instagram discontinued third-party access for personal accounts, Facebook is the primary social source and the flow points former Instagram users here or to the app. Books are ordered as Small or Large Hardcover in seven currencies and can be reordered for other years or gifted to family; Facebook data is used only for the order and deleted on request under the Meta Platform Terms.

products.name: Web Photo Book Creator
products.description: The browser creator on pastbook.com for customers whose photos live on a computer, in Dropbox or in Google Drive: photos are uploaded over encrypted connections, indexed by timestamp and location, and curated into moments in under 60 seconds. The web editor exposes the full personalisation set (page order, swapping and removing photos, captions and a quote, cover photo, theme colours and the back-cover photo add-on) on a large screen, which travellers and milestone celebrants use more than app customers. Format and cover rules follow the page count (up to 16 pages softcover, 18-26 choice of soft or hard cover for a fee, 27-300 hardcover by default, above 300 softcover) and prices are shown in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, NZD or BRL. The creator runs in ten site languages and shares checkout, payments and print routing with the app.

primaryCustomers.name: Traveller and Milestone Celebrant
primaryCustomers.description: Builds a large hardcover of the trip from a laptop full of camera and phone photos, with fine control over cover, order and captions.

primaryCustomers.name: Facebook Timeline Archivist

products.name: Year in Review Photo Book
products.description: PastBook's signature seasonal product and the core of the Q4 campaign: a yearbook of the past twelve months built from the phone (Yearbook mode) or from a Facebook year, promoted in ten languages with the 10+ million books created since 2012 as social proof. Lifecycle reminders and push messages trigger the annual habit, the curation engine picks the best moments across the year and the layout adds dates and captions automatically. The product is sold as a Small Hardcover from USD 19.99 or Large Hardcover from USD 34.99 with promotional discounts and free-shipping upgrades to hard cover or a bigger copy, and holiday order-by dates are derived from production time plus the country delivery window. Repeat orders of past years and gift copies for grandparents are one tap away from the order history.

products.name: Photo Wall Calendars

The layout engine picks one strong photo or a collage per month and applies the chosen theme colours; the customer can swap a month's photo and set the start month before checkout. Calendars are printed on FSC-certified paper by the partner facility nearest the customer and shipped within the standard country delivery windows, and multi-product orders ship together on the longest production time. They are the main gifting format outside books and peak with the Year in Review campaign.

Posters use the same cart, payment methods and seven currencies as the books, are produced by the partner facility in the customer's region and ship within the published delivery windows. They serve travellers who want the one hero shot of a trip on the wall and gift givers who add a poster to a book order.
